plainTranslation: With Composite Mercury in the 11th house, you can be open to what you each think, and allow one another to express yourselves without feeling like you have to be a certain way. You can talk about your hopes and dreams together, and may be a little idealistic about the relationship, but you can get along and understand each other so well that you feel the relationship can endure. This can be an excellent position for a friendship since the 11th house rules your friendships.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
